title: The First Light
text: My rushlight is the only light left in the fen. Help me keep it burning: collect from the stall a few times, and maybe others will see it and come home.
doneText: It's still burning. More than that, it's brighter. Someone out there will have seen it.

title: Push Back the Murk
text: The gloom creeps right up to my door. Tap the murk at the edge of town and cleanse it. Every patch we reclaim is a patch the Thief doesn't have.
doneText: Look at that. Real grass. I'd forgotten what green looked like.

title: A Place to Stay
text: Folk won't stay without somewhere to sleep. Build another cottage, and I'll put the kettle on for whoever turns up.
doneText: Two cottages. That's practically a village.

title: Light the Way
text: Folk find their way by lamplight. Put up three Rushlight Posts near the shops, and watch how much longer people linger.
doneText: Three posts, three little lights. The town looks like it's waking up.

title: Warm Ovens
text: An oven's no good cold. Collect 90 glimmer from a Mossbread Oven, and I'll show you what a real bakery looks like.
doneText: Now that's a proper bake. Let's talk about cakes.

title: A Proper Cake
text: Bread's all very well. But a town needs cake. Turn the oven into a real Mossbread Bakery.
doneText: Honey cakes in the window. People stopped in the street. I saw a frog cry.

title: Room for Wanderers
text: I've met plenty of folk on the road who'd settle here, if there was room. Get Fenlight to four residents and I'll spread the word.
doneText: Four! I'll be telling everyone between here and the deep fen.

title: Tea in the Rain
text: There's nothing a cup of mushroom tea can't fix. Build a Tea Cart and I'll prove it.
doneText: Steeped for exactly as long as it rained. Perfect.

title: Tea Fit for a Court
text: A proper teahouse needs proper custom. Collect 2,000 glimmer from your tea shop and folk will come from all over.
doneText: Two thousand glimmer of tea. I've decided to call it a tradition.

title: Seeds in the Peat
text: I've brought seeds from three counties and none of them like the murk. Build a Peat Garden and we'll see what grows.
doneText: Sundew! And bogbean! And something I can't identify, which is exciting.

title: A Remedy for the Fen
text: Half the town has murk-cough. Collect 12,000 glimmer from your apothecary so we can stock up on remedies.
doneText: Nobody's coughed all week. I've never been so bored. Wonderful.

title: The Old Ferry
text: There used to be a ferry here. There used to be a lot of things. Build me a Ferry Landing and I'll show you the channels.
doneText: There. Now the fen has a way across it again.

title: Lanterns in the Reeds
text: I tended every lantern in this fen before the Thief came. I want them back. Start with a Lantern Repair Bench.
doneText: The first mended lantern. It's not much. It's a start.

title: Half the Fen
text: The Thief's trail runs through the murk. Cleanse six more patches and we'll be able to follow it.
doneText: There. Do you see the scorch marks on the reeds? That's where the lanterns were taken.

title: The Thief's Trail
text: The trail leads somewhere deep and dark. We'll need a bigger town behind us before we go looking. Reach level 9.
doneText: We're ready. Or as ready as anyone can be. The Thief is out there, and now we know where to look.

title: A Lamp for Sorrel
text: I came back because I saw a lit window. I'd like to see a thousand. Turn the Rushlight Stall into a Glimmerwick Chandlery.
doneText: Every window in town is lit. I could weep. I won't. But I could.
